label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), following an unrewarded trial, with an uncertain policy
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition (in_action=2, in_state=2: every activation). Within that condition it needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward==0 carries 93% of mass) and the model policy logit at this step to be near zero (choice in [-1.5, 2.8) carries 92% of mass), so it is a common a2/S2 arrival while the agent is unsure. It is enriched on switch trials (stay==0, 5.8x lift) and when a2 is not the good choice, but those are weaker than the uncertainty condition. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, on S1, or on rare transitions, and almost never late in an episode (trials 80+). The bare condition D2 & a2 & S2 & prev_reward==0 covers 98% of the top activation quartile but has precision 0.17; adding the choice-logit window raises dev F1 to 0.67. All variables are observed or computed by the agent, so no future variables are used. Magnitude is graded within the condition and is not fully captured here.
